summary: assemble options: file attributes, backup, vault decryption of sources, a delimiter between fragments, the required dest, group ownership, and ignoring hidden files.
questions: How do I insert a separator between fragments with assemble?
How do I keep a backup of the old file when assembling?
How do I skip dotfiles in the fragment directory?
How do I set the group owner of the assembled file?

answer_card.title: assemble parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `dest` (required): file to create
- `delimiter`: text placed between fragments
- `backup` (false): keep a timestamped backup
- `decrypt` (true): auto-decrypt vaulted sources
- `ignore_hidden` (false): skip files starting with `.`
- `group`: group owner (numeric = GID)
- `attributes`: chattr-style attributes
